section_summary.extract_value: This section presents clinical implications and therapeutic recommendations for professionals working with women and caregivers. It emphasizes the importance of body appreciation in clinical interventions and suggests specific strategies such as cognitive dissonance interventions, mindfulness practices, and challenging media messages to help clients develop positive body image and reject perfectionism.

section_summary.extract_value: This section provides clinical implications of a path model study examining relationships between parental messages, attachment styles, perfectionism, body appreciation, and eating behaviors. The text discusses how professionals can help caregivers understand the impact of their messages on daughters' body appreciation and eating patterns, and recommends therapeutic interventions to promote body appreciation through cognitive dissonance techniques and mindfulness strategies.
